trust_decision.summary: Gemm version-converter adapters trust the rank of A and B declared in the model's value_info and index dims [0]/[1] without checking rank == 2; the only pre-existing check (assertInputsAvailable) verifies shape presence and int dims, not rank.

landing_point.why: Summary names the Gemm version-converter adapter and an undersized input shape; the 7->6 adapter with A_shape[1]/B_shape[1] indexing is the obvious first file.

fix_sites.module_kind: version-converter adapter (C++ header, registered at onnx/version_converter/convert.h:250)

fix_sites.entry_point: same as above, upward conversion opset 6->7
fix_sites.module_kind: version-converter adapter (C++ header, registered at onnx/version_converter/convert.h:236)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: onnx/inliner/inliner.cc:461 (inline_local_functions with convert_version=True wraps function bodies as a model and calls ConvertVersion; shapes come from InferShapes at onnx/inliner/inliner.cc:419 and GetType at :438). Fixed implicitly because the published fix sits in the adapters, not at a separate site.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The inliner route is a different feature (function inlining) that a solver would not consider; but since the fix lives inside the shared adapters it is covered automatically, so there is nothing to dismiss.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Valid rank-2 Gemm conversions with transA/transB and a broadcastable C of rank 0-2 must keep working; an over-broad fix that demands C rank 2 or equal shapes would break C broadcast (broadcast attribute set at gemm_7_6.h:52-54).

O7_producer.where: onnx/common/ir_pb_converter.cc:291-293 (value_info shape -> Value sizes); onnx/inliner/inliner.cc:419,438 for the inliner route

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an axis-attribute aware backward broadcast that indexes A_sizes[axis + i] from a node attribute without a rank bound
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the forward adapter already reads kaxis against sizes (broadcast_forward_compatibility.h:33-34) and helper.cc:22-27 indexes input1_sizes[axis + i]; a maintainer handling legacy axis broadcasting could write the indexing directly.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: reading input dims at the axis (e.g. sizes()[axis]) to pick Flatten/Reshape shape without range-checking the attribute axis against rank
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the adapter already computes axis from rank with no bound check on positive axis; a dim lookup there is a natural extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a down-conversion Upsample_7_6 reading input_shape[2]/[3] to rebuild height/width scales without the rank==4 check the upward adapter has
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: mirrors the Gemm pair exactly: one direction checks rank, the other trusts it.
